<!-- Adding or updating a plugin: one file in plugins/, named after the plugin id. -->

- [ ] `DeckHost --check-plugin` passes on the package
- [ ] `sha256` is the checksum of the file at `download_url` (or this is a paid plugin with `purchase_url`)
- [ ] `permissions` lists what the plugin does beyond drawing and reacting to keys
- [ ] I'm the author, or I have the author's permission to list it
